articles.summary: For SBA lenders, growing loan volume can create an operational challenge. articles.summary: Automated credit decisioning uses data, predefined credit policies, decision rules, and increasingly machine learning to evaluate credit applications and determine what should happen next. Instead of requiring an underwriter to manually collect data, calculate ratios, review every policy requirement, and make each decision independently, an automated system can complete much of that work in seconds.

articles.summary: Continuous underwriting is the ongoing reassessment of borrower risk as relevant financial and operating data changes. Instead of treating underwriting as a decision made once at application, a lender refreshes approved data, evaluates defined risk signals, and routes the result through a governed workflow throughout the credit relationship.

articles.summary: A data aggregation platform pulls banking, business, and credit data into one place so lending teams can decide faster. articles.summary: Financial data aggregation helps underwriting by collecting borrower information from multiple sources, standardizing it, and making it available within one decision workflow. Instead of asking an analyst to move between credit bureau portals, bank statements, accounting systems, identity tools, and PDFs, aggregation creates a more complete and usable borrower profile.
